headline: Inkling 2 Small Challenges Leading Open-Weight Models in Western Market
summary: Thinking Machines, led by Mira Murati, has launched Inkling 2 Small, a 594 billion parameter model that outperforms existing open-weight models. This advancement is reshaping the landscape of AI development, particularly in the Western market.
whyItMatters: This model's performance could accelerate local AI agent deployment and reduce reliance on proprietary platforms, making advanced AI more accessible.
